title: RBRA Vessel Buy-Back Program - County Payment and Grant Accounting Records, Malcolm Emails re CF 3944 TZ, Fiscal Agreements with RBRA

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the California Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

The following records of the County of Marin (including the Community Development Agency, the Department of Finance, and County Counsel) concerning the Richardson Bay Regional Agency ("RBRA"), for which the County has provided staff, email, and fiscal services:

1. All records of any payment, disbursement, reimbursement, or accounting entry made by or through the County on behalf of RBRA relating to RBRA's Vessel Buy-Back Program from June 16, 2022 to the present, including any payment to or through MarinLink and any payment relating to a floating home bearing California registration number CF 3944 TZ.

2. All records identifying the fund, grant, or appropriation from which RBRA Vessel Buy-Back Program payments were made or reimbursed, including Department of Finance records of grant receipts from the California Department of Boating and Waterways, NOAA, or the California Ocean Protection Council credited to RBRA from January 1, 2022 to the present.

3. All emails sent or received by James Malcolm (jmalcolm@marincounty.org / james.malcolm@marincounty.gov) between January 1, 2024 and June 30, 2025 that contain any of the following terms: "3944"; "Moyer"; "floating home"; "buyback"; "buy back"; "buy-back"; "MarinLink"; "affidavit of ownership"; "statement of ownership"; "SAVE"; "NOAA".

4. The County's fiscal sponsorship, administrative services, staffing, or joint powers agreement(s) with RBRA in effect at any time from January 1, 2022 to the present.

Please produce electronically and identify the exemption relied on for any record withheld.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 calendar days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Robbie Powelson

title: Vessel Buy-Back Program - Payment, Funding Source, Grant Claims and Ownership Verification Records for Floating Home CF 3944 TZ and All Buyback Vessels

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the California Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

The following RBRA records, including records held for RBRA by Regional Government Services, MarinLink, or the County of Marin:

1. All records of payment to any person in connection with the Vessel Buy-Back Program for the floating home bearing California registration number CF 3944 TZ (the floating home formerly occupied by Diane Moyer) and the three motor vessels surrendered with it, including the three MarinLink check requests dated on or about February 27, March 6, and April 23, 2024; cancelled checks or payment confirmations; the fund, account, grant, or budget line to which each payment was charged; and any general-ledger or accounting entry for those payments.

2. All records showing the source of funds for the Vessel Buy-Back Program from June 16, 2022 to the present, including board resolutions, budget documents, and any grant, appropriation, or agreement (state, federal, or BCDC-related) used to pay or reimburse buyback payments.

3. All reimbursement claims, invoices, reports, or cost-share/match documentation submitted by RBRA to the California Department of Boating and Waterways, NOAA, the California Ocean Protection Council, or any other funder from January 1, 2024 to the present that include the floating home CF 3944 TZ, the vessels surrendered with it, or any Vessel Buy-Back Program payment.

4. Every "Affidavit of Ownership," "Statement of Ownership," or similar ownership determination executed by RBRA staff or by a buyback applicant for any vessel or floating home acquired under the Vessel Buy-Back Program from June 16, 2022 to the present, together with the DMV registration record, title search, or other ownership verification obtained for each vessel.

5. All records of any DMV registration check, title search, or inquiry concerning CF 3944 TZ from January 1, 2021 to the present, including the March 2021 registration inquiry and any notes or statements memorializing telephone inquiries to the DMV.

6. All communications from January 1, 2024 to the present between RBRA staff (including James Malcolm, Brad Gross, Karen Prows, and Jenna Brady) and any funder, MarinLink, or the County of Marin concerning the buyback of CF 3944 TZ.

I am not requesting records already produced in RBRA PRA No. 26-21. Please produce electronically and identify the exemption relied on for any record withheld.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 calendar days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Robbie Powelson

title: Award NA21NOS9990023 (Richardson's Bay Regional Agency) - Progress Reports with Narrative, SF-425s, Drawdowns, Match Documentation, Amendments, Correspondence

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Records held by the NOAA Marine Debris Program (Office of Response and Restoration), the National Ocean Service, and the NOAA Grants Management Division concerning Federal Award NA21NOS9990023 to the Richardson's Bay Regional Agency, San Rafael, California ("Abandoned and Derelict Vessel Removal in Richardson's Bay to Support Eelgrass Habitat Recovery"; CFDA 11.999; period of performance 9/1/2021-2/29/2024; Federal Program Officer Tom Barry):

1. All Performance Progress Reports (interim and final) submitted by the recipient, together with every attachment, including the "performance narrative" attachment referenced in Box 16 of the final Performance Progress Report certified June 28, 2024.

2. All Federal Financial Reports (SF-425) submitted for the award.

3. All requests for payment / drawdown requests (ASAP or otherwise) and NOAA's disbursement records for the award, showing the amount and date of each payment.

4. All documentation of non-federal cost share / match claimed by the recipient, including any schedule of match sources (California Department of Boating and Waterways SAVE grants; California Ocean Protection Council) and any vessel-level cost or match detail submitted to NOAA.

5. All award amendments, no-cost extension requests and approvals (including the extension of the period of performance from 8/31/2023 to 2/29/2024), budget revisions (including the budget change approved on or about April 5, 2022), and closeout documents.

6. All correspondence between NOAA staff (including Federal Program Officer Tom Barry and the Grants Officer) and the recipient or its consultants (including Curtis Havel, James Malcolm, Brad Gross, and Rebecca Schwartz Lesberg / Coastal Policy Solutions) from September 1, 2021 to the present concerning the award, including any communication referring to a "floating home," a "buyback" or "buy-back" program, or California vessel registration number CF 3944 TZ.

I already hold the Form CD-450 award document and the final Performance Progress Report form; I am not requesting the FY2021 application. I request electronic copies. I request a fee waiver under 5 U.S.C. 552(a)(4)(A)(iii): disclosure will significantly contribute to public understanding of how federal marine-debris funds were expended and matched by a local government agency, and I have no commercial interest in the records. If a waiver is denied, please notify me before incurring fees above $50.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Robbie Powelson

title: RBRA SAVE Grant Claims 2022-2025 (C22S0608 and FY23-24, FY24-25), VTIP and AWAF claim forms, CF 3944 TZ

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the California Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

Records of the Division of Boating and Waterways (DBW) concerning the Richardson Bay Regional Agency ("RBRA") under the Surrendered and Abandoned Vessel Exchange (SAVE) Program:

1. All reimbursement claims submitted by RBRA under SAVE grant agreement C22S0608 (FY 2022-23) and under RBRA's FY 2023-24 and FY 2024-25 SAVE grant agreements, including every Abandoned Watercraft Abatement Fund (AWAF) Reimbursement Claim Form, every Vessel Turn-In Program (VTIP) Reimbursement Claim Form (DPR 264), every Itemized 10% In-Kind Contribution Statement (DPR 265), and all supporting documentation submitted with each claim (invoices, proof of payment, photographs, Vessel Release of Interest and Ownership forms, statements of ownership, DMV records, and OLGA claim submissions).

2. All payment records showing amounts paid by DBW to RBRA under those agreements, identifying the claim each payment satisfied.

3. RBRA's FY 2023-24 and FY 2024-25 SAVE grant applications and fully executed grant agreements, with all exhibits.

4. Any claim, vessel list, release form, or correspondence submitted to DBW by RBRA that refers to a floating home bearing California registration number CF 3944 TZ, or to a 60-foot wooden floating home surrendered or turned in to RBRA between January 1, 2024 and December 31, 2024.

5. All correspondence between DBW staff and RBRA (including James Malcolm, Brad Gross, Curtis Havel, Karen Prows, or Rebecca Schwartz Lesberg) from January 1, 2022 to the present concerning RBRA's Vessel Buy-Back Program, "buyback" or "buy-back" payments, or whether buyback expenditures or vessels surrendered under the buyback may be claimed under SAVE.

Time period: January 1, 2022 to the date of your response unless stated otherwise. If any record is withheld, please identify it and the exemption relied on. I am not requesting records already produced to me in State Parks PRA Nos. 22-615, 22-682, or 23-752.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 calendar days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Robbie Powelson
